connectorUiConfig.title: RedRays SAP Security Findings
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Bring RedRays SAP security findings into Microsoft Sentinel. Review vulnerability assessments, ABAP code findings, BTP security, segregation of duties, profile parameter checks and password security in one workbook, with analytics rules for findings that need attention. RedRays pushes data on a schedule you choose through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and stays in your existing on-premises or cloud environment. This connector does not collect SAP Security Audit Log events or populate ABAPAuditLog. You need a RedRays license with Microsoft Sentinel integration. Azure ingestion and retention charges apply.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy the push connector resources
instructionSteps.description: Select **Deploy** to create a data collection endpoint (DCE), a data collection rule (DCR) and the eight RedRays tables in this workspace. Microsoft Sentinel also creates a Microsoft Entra app registration with a client secret and grants it the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the DCR, so RedRays can send data with OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Workspace shared keys are not used.

parameters.text: The client secret is shown only once, right after deployment. Copy it immediately. If you miss it, open Microsoft Entra ID > App registrations, select **RedRays SAP Security Findings**, and create a new client secret under Certificates & secrets.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure RedRays
instructionSteps.description: In RedRays, open **Platform Settings > Microsoft Sentinel** and enter the values below. Choose the modules to export and how often to send data. Keep baseline alerting disabled for the first import, then save and enable the integration. RedRays needs outbound HTTPS access to Microsoft Entra and the data collection endpoint. No inbound connection is required.

parameters.label: Application (client) ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy the push connector to get the application ID

parameters.label: Client secret
parameters.placeholder: Deploy the push connector to get the client secret

parameters.placeholder: Deploy the push connector to get the DCE URI

parameters.label: DCR immutable ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy the push connector to get the DCR immutable ID

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify delivery
instructionSteps.description: Send a test event from RedRays, then wait for a scheduled export. Query RedRaysExportHealth_CL for RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT'. A successful test means Azure accepted the request; the record may take a few minutes to appear in queries. RedRays sends each module to its own stream (Custom-RedRaysExportHealth_CL, Custom-RedRaysScanRuns_CL, Custom-RedRaysVulnerabilities_CL, Custom-RedRaysAbapFindings_CL, Custom-RedRaysCloudFindings_CL, Custom-RedRaysSoDFindings_CL, Custom-RedRaysProfileChecks_CL and Custom-RedRaysPasswordFindings_CL) on the same DCR.

instructionSteps.title: 4. Enable security content
instructionSteps.description: Open Manage solution to create the workbook and selected analytics rules from templates. Review the initial findings before enabling rules. Most finding rules alert on actionable High or Critical candidates. The profile rule raises Medium severity alerts for VULNERABLE checks. The workbook flags heartbeats older than 60 minutes; adjust the threshold above your export interval and expected ingestion delay. Disable equivalent rules from earlier RedRays deployments to avoid duplicate alerts. For help, contact support@redrays.io.
